properties.name: A null unsets a field at every typed constructor, not only at create_node
properties.rationale: The Shop sample trial (2026-10-24) sent `limit: null` to add_constraint and the limit stayed: a typed request reads an explicit null and an absent key as the same None, so the merge kept the stored value. The 2026-09-07 rule (chg:eight-field-feedback-fixes-land-for-v0510) was built into create_node's props bag only — a rule settled at one door and never reached the others. The cure is at the class, not the instance: the null is carried in the request type every constructor takes, and the guard is a test whose membership is the served surface (every add_* tool and every tool promising "optional to revise") and whose properties are the schema's, so a new constructor or field joins without anyone listing it. Observed failing first on main's source (307 problems across all 24 constructors), passing after the fix with the whole MCP in-memory suite. Choices left for Anthony: a null on `distinct_from` erases the recorded near-match judgement the schema calls additive history, and a null on a defaulted `status` puts the default back (a realized capability reads planned) — both follow the rule as accepted. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_018ibUbMKCS1yK5W17cncp9P
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: Builds dec:null-unsets-on-every-typed-constructor. nulls.rs: Nullable<T> keeps the fields sent as null beside the typed request (schema unchanged: all 200 served schemas and descriptions compared equal to the toolsnap goldens), unset_nulled / node_after_unset remove them after each constructor's writes. Wired into all 21 add_* constructors, plan_epoch and record_finding; RequiredFields::refuse_nulled refuses a null on a field the constructor needs to create the node; add_inference's null name puts back its computed name. The reply lists `unset`. Tests that build a request in code pass it with `.into()` (mechanical, 50+ test files). No tool description stated the old behaviour, so none changed; a changelog fragment says what a client sending null for every empty field must now do.
